create_config_entry_decorator: create a decorator to mark a staticmethod as the config entry-point for a class
get_class_config_method: get the fully qualified name of the config entry method annotated with @config_entry on a class
get_class_name_str: get the fully qualified module and class name string for a given class definition
review_config_entry_usage: review a class to verify it has exactly one staticmethod annotated with the config_entry decorator
test_get_class_config_method: test that get_class_config_method raises ValueError when a class has no or multiple config_entry methods
